title: Project 3 — Explainable Credit Risk Model for Thin-File Borrowers
summary: A credit-scoring project that predicts probability of default for 'thin-file' loan applicants lacking traditional credit bureau history, using alternative data features and SHAP explanations exposed via a Streamlit app. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, fit on thin-file applicant data and sampled to generate synthetic thin-file profiles for augmenting the dataset.
